problem: Container-valued transformations mutate borrowed primitive builtin inputs before returning a replacement; exception-only validation must distinguish actual values from nullable command return contracts.
scope: Undecorated functions/methods with direct builtin container return/input annotations and primitive input elements. Track bounded aliases, item/method/in-place mutation, structured if joins, literal reachability and eager comprehension scope/evaluation order. Preserve command/result scalar APIs, decorated frameworks, receiver state, I/O, opaque types and unsupported orchestration. Compound assignment/deletion targets and unpacking are excluded. Local annotations do not execute in a function and annotation-only targets do not perform writes; their evaluated receiver/index operands remain checked.
returnContractCorrection: SARJ519 now follows stable source return aliases and first-party type imports, while distinguishing top-level unions and Annotated type content from collection elements/metadata. Nullable, generic, object, structural-protocol and unresolved contracts abstain.

validation.seedPositive: Original motivating expression remains detected at line162,column9.

classification.note: The sole diagnostic is byte-identical to the previously inspected validation true positive. No unseeded container positives means empirical precision cannot be estimated.

performance.method: Separate process per corpus and mode; first invocation cold, then median of three fresh-session warm invocations; baseline is all shipped Python rules except the candidate, combined adds the candidate.

performanceLimit: First25 sorted pinned self-source files,190220bytes. Host contention; medians are observations and imply neither speedup nor fleet performance. Baseline excludes both reviewed rules; candidate measures both; combined includes161 rules.
privacy: Immutable private source identities, digests, raw findings and exact local replay commands remain in an owner-only overlay. Public report includes only aggregate private labels. Application modules were never imported.

recommendation: Keep both rules at warning with no autofix. Promotion requires a separate metadata change after the warning release and qualifying evidence. Consumer changes go through the rollout controller after publication.
precisionFollowup: Four runtime counterexamples showed false warnings from compound targets and local annotations. Final source excludes compound/unpacking target ownership and visits only actual annotated values/target operands. All four now produce no warning; four controls retain genuine item/index/value/alias mutations.
